title: Connect components quickly
body: Union-find tracks which items belong to the same connected component.
takeaway: Path compression and union by rank make repeated checks nearly constant time.

title: Order dependent work
body: Which algorithm orders a directed acyclic graph by prerequisites?
takeaway: Topological order places every prerequisite before its dependents.

title: Share common prefixes
body: A trie stores words character by character, sharing nodes for common prefixes.
takeaway: Tries fit prefix lookup and autocomplete.

title: Carry success or failure
body: An Either-like type stores one of two explicit outcomes.
takeaway: Typed outcomes make expected failures visible to callers.

title: Read transformations left to right
body: A pipeline names each transformation and keeps intermediate mutation out.
takeaway: Short pipelines make data flow obvious.

title: Describe a transition
body: What should a pure reducer return?
options: A new state from state plus action

title: Space retries out
body: Exponential backoff increases delay after each transient failure.
takeaway: Add jitter so many clients do not retry together.

title: Separate deploy from release
body: What lets code ship while behavior remains disabled?
takeaway: Flags reduce rollout risk but need ownership and cleanup.

title: Read local, sync remote
body: Offline-first apps serve cached data immediately and reconcile when connected.
takeaway: Treat network availability as optional, not guaranteed.

title: Speed up a lookup
body: What database structure trades write cost and storage for faster queries?
takeaway: Index columns used often for filtering, joining, and ordering.
